chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from his father Muhammad ibn Isa, who said:
I entered upon Abu Jaʿfar al-Thani عليه السلام, and he discussed with me certain matters. Then he said to me: “O Abu Ali, doubt has been removed; there is no one for my father other than me.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الثَّانِي: Abu Jaʿfar the Second, the Imam being referred to in the narration
key_terms.الشَّكُّ: doubt or uncertainty concerning the matter under discussion
key_terms.فَنَاظَرَنِي: he engaged me in discussion or examination regarding certain matters
key_terms.مَا لِأَبِي غَيْرِي: my father has no one besides me, indicating exclusive succession

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Abu Jaʿfar al-Thani عليه السلام remove doubt about his succession after his father?
ai.summary: This hadith records a statement of Imam Abu Jaʿfar al-Thani عليه السلام affirming his exclusive designation after his father. Its significance lies in removing uncertainty regarding succession and establishing clarity about the Imam’s authority.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from his father Muhammad Bin Isa who said,

‘I went over to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> debated with me regarding the things, then said to me: ‘O Abu Ali! Raise your doubts! There is none for my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> apart from me<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from his father, Muhammad ibn ‘Isa who has said the following.
“Once I went to see abu Ja‘far al-Thani’s (a.s.). He debated me in several issues. He then said, “O abu Ali, there is no (reason for) doubt; I am the only son that my father had.”
